prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” interior painting company for all jobs in St. Louis — the right contractor depends on your needs (residential vs. commercial), budget, timeline, and the scope/complexity of the job. I can, however, help you find a top choice for your situation. A few quick options:

If you want me to look up local companies and give you a short list of top-rated painters near you, tell me your zip code or neighborhood and whether this is a home or business job (and a rough size — number of rooms, square footage, or ceilings vs. trim vs. full paint).

If you prefer to search yourself, here’s how to pick the best painter and what to ask:

1. Where to check
- Google and Yelp reviews
- Angi (Angie’s List), Houzz
- Better Business Bureau (BBB)
- Nextdoor recommendations
- Ask neighbors / local Facebook groups for firsthand referrals

2. Key qualifications to confirm
- Properly insured (liability and workers’ comp)
- Local business license if required
- References and a portfolio of recent interior work
- Written contract and detailed, itemized estimate
- Warranty/guarantee on labor and finish

3. Questions to ask each painter
- Do you carry insurance and can you provide a certificate?
- Are you licensed in Missouri (if applicable)?
- Can I see photos of similar past jobs and references?
- What surface prep will you do (patching, sanding, priming)?
- Exactly what’s included in the price (number of coats, trim, doors, cleanup)?
- Timeline: start date and estimated completion?
- What products/brands do you use and do you offer color consultation?
- How do you handle unexpected issues or additional costs?

4. Red flags
- Demands large upfront cash payments
- No written estimate or contract
- Poor or no online reviews, or many unresolved complaints
- Uses high-pressure sales tactics

If you give your zip code and a few job details (home vs. commercial, number of rooms, any special needs like high ceilings or faux finishes), I’ll pull a short list of well-reviewed interior painters in St. Louis and summarize their strengths so you can compare.
